purpose: Control automatic lease takeover, one guarded incompatible-store wipe, and lease-gated reconciliation and app-side group cleanup.

public_api.name: startAccountLifecycle
public_api.description: Start one abortable account generation, resolve readiness on the first lease outcome, retry lease-held, dispose before release, and run the once-per-page wipe before closing the incompatible session stores.

public_api.name: clearAllGroupData
public_api.description: Clear app group-owned state for the current account, including history and persisted group stores, preserving DM and contacts.

public_api.name: reconcileOverlayGroups
public_api.description: While lease held, purge overlay ids absent from the library snapshot via the existing local group purger.

owned_data: Lease outcome and page-local wipe attempt guard
dependencies_allowed: existing group store clear helpers and history barrel
dependencies_forbidden: group writes while not holding a lease
